name: Pursuit Scout
purpose: Live, citable opportunity briefs from one-line client + context inputs.
guardrails: Citations required on every claim
Synthetic figures clearly watermarked
Deal-size hypothesis is a band, never a single number
human_checkpoints: Partner reviews and either Approves, Edits, or Rejects

name: POV Author
purpose: Brand-correct, citation-bound POV deliverables in HTML, ready for the client meeting.
guardrails: Pyramid structure enforced
Every section bound to ≥1 evidence row
Cognirise brand chrome locked

name: Proposal Composer
purpose: Formal proposal with workplan, team, pricing, terms, compliance matrix.
guardrails: Every promise maps to a workplan deliverable
Pricing must hit target margin or trigger Partner override
Compliance matrix 100% green or rendered red

name: Meeting Scribe
purpose: Turn a meeting recording or transcript into structured engagement memory.
guardrails: Speaker attribution preserved or marked unclear
Confidential terms flagged before any cross-engagement write
human_checkpoints: Summary + action items reviewed before push to engagement
Prototype brief, if generated, requires explicit click

name: Charter Architect
purpose: Engagement charter and hypothesis tree within 24h of signature.
guardrails: Every objective paired with a measurable success metric
Scope and out-of-scope MECE
Hypothesis tree limited to 3 levels by default

name: Agent Architect
purpose: Process diagram + agentifiability annotations + candidate agent designs.
guardrails: Agentifiability classification includes rationale
No candidate agent without a human checkpoint
High-risk agents flagged for Partner attention
human_checkpoints: Partner / Engagement Lead reviews each design

name: Prototype Forge
purpose: Replit-ready build prompts (DGE Effortless pattern) for viable prototype ideas.
guardrails: Generated prompts include Cognirise non-negotiables block
No real client data without Partner approval

name: Synthesis Critic
purpose: Quality-gate every external deliverable before client release.
guardrails: Critic does not edit; only flags
Send-to-client blocked unless GREEN or Partner override logged

name: Triage Agent
purpose: Composes the persona's Pane A 'what needs me today' queue.
guardrails: Never re-orders Partner-flagged items
human_checkpoints: Implicit via Approve/Snooze on each item

name: RAID Watchdog
purpose: Flags risks/assumptions/issues/dependencies on every engagement.
guardrails: Severity escalation requires Engagement Lead acknowledgement

name: Knowledge Concierge
purpose: Answers firm-wide search with citations from the Atelier.
guardrails: Cross-engagement reads logged

name: Atelier Curator
purpose: Identifies reusable IP candidates and proposes Atelier promotions.
guardrails: Partner approves every promotion

name: Prompt Librarian
purpose: Watches for repeating prompt patterns; proposes library entries.
guardrails: Eval suite must pass at or above current active version

name: Diagnostic Memo Author
purpose: Drafts diagnostic deliverables from hypothesis tree + evidence.
guardrails: Off-hypothesis sections flagged

name: Workplan Architect
purpose: Builds the engagement workplan from the charter.
guardrails: No undated workstreams

name: Adoption Coach
purpose: Drives change adoption and value tracking post-launch.
guardrails: Adoption metrics tied to value case

name: Value Case Tracker
purpose: Tracks realised value vs. case across the engagement lifecycle.
guardrails: Calls out drift > 15% to Partner

name: Compliance Reviewer
purpose: Builds the compliance matrix for proposal responses.
guardrails: Red rows surfaced before submission

name: Pricing Analyst
purpose: Models proposal pricing against firm margin targets.
guardrails: Below-target prices block submission

name: Bench Planner
purpose: Skill-graph + bench planning (v2 — registered for visibility).

name: Brand Translator
purpose: Inherits Cognirise brand defaults; supports per-engagement overrides.
guardrails: Brand chrome locked unless overridden

name: Storyboarder
purpose: Demo storyboards for prototype briefs.

name: Account Cartographer
purpose: Re-map an account's reality — leadership changes, strategic priorities, signals — and propose governed updates to the account profile.
guardrails: Every proposed update must include a citation
Writes only to pendingProfileUpdates queue (never live fields)
Partner approval required before any field is overwritten
human_checkpoints: Partner reviews each proposed delta and Approves / Rejects

name: Whitespace Mapper
purpose: Cross-tabulate Cognirise offerings × buyer personas inside an account to surface the next 3 priority moves.
guardrails: Only personas already mapped on the account can be scored
Priority moves capped at 3 per refresh

name: QBR Composer
purpose: Compose a quarterly business-review canvas — wins, risks, next moves — bound to the account's engagements + signals.
guardrails: Sections must cite engagements or signals — no ungrounded claims
Risk flags rendered amber, not buried

name: Pipeline Forecaster
purpose: Roll up the 10-stage sales pipeline into a weighted forecast and flag stalled deals into Pane A for the partner-owner.
guardrails: Probabilities use the published stage defaults unless explicitly overridden
Stalled = >21 days in stage, in-flight stages only
Read-only with respect to opportunity records — only writes Pane A items + agent runs
human_checkpoints: Partner reviews stalled-deal Pane A items

name: Win/Loss Interviewer
purpose: Impartial third-party interviewer. Synthesizes async buyer transcript into buyer-authentic reasons + themes bound to verbatim evidence.
guardrails: Conductor: never identifies as the deal owner
Distinguish seller-perceived from buyer-authentic reasons
Every theme must be bound to a verbatim quote
Hidden competitor: name one of {direct, partner_firm, status_quo, inhouse, unknown}
human_checkpoints: Partner reviews and approves before themes feed the curator

name: Theme Curator
purpose: Clusters approved debrief themes into the firm-wide Win Themes library. Suggests where to insert positioning lines into open proposals.
guardrails: Only ingests themes from APPROVED debriefs (never draft)
Emergent themes flagged separately from upserts

name: Feedback Distiller
purpose: Stub (Task #241 OOS). Will distill in-flight engagement feedback into RAID + lessons.
guardrails: Stub — not wired in v2

name: Publish Sentinel
purpose: DLP scan of every deliverable before it is published to a client workspace.
guardrails: Hard-block on Saudi national ID, IBAN, PAN; soft-warn on INTERNAL-ONLY markers
Never auto-redact — surface findings to a human
human_checkpoints: Engagement Lead reviews Sentinel output before publish

name: Salon Concierge
purpose: Onboards client users to a Salon workspace; drafts invite copy and IdP records.
guardrails: Engagement Lead approves the invitation batch before send

name: Engagement Curator
purpose: Weekly synthesis of decisions, deliverables, and next steps for the client view.
guardrails: Synthesised facts always cited to a Salon record
human_checkpoints: Engagement Lead signs off the weekly digest

name: Approval Choreographer
purpose: Drives the approval chain state machine — request → reviewers → decision → audit.
guardrails: Approver role required for any 'approve' transition

name: Access Sentinel
purpose: Validates engagement-access grants. Blocks pricing/margin scope for non-employees, freezes grants on closed engagements, and writes an audit row for every grant or revoke.
guardrails: Pricing and margin scope are denied for contractors and partner-firm resources
Grants on closed engagements are frozen — Sentinel proposes revocation instead
Only Partner / Operations / Engagement Lead may write grants
human_checkpoints: Operations confirms revocation when an engagement closes

name: Onboarding Concierge
purpose: Generates onboarding sequences from invitations. Holds the sequence open while any compliance gate (NDA, payroll, MSA) is blocked.
guardrails: Only Partner / Operations can initiate invitations
Compliance-gate steps cannot be skipped — only blocked or done
Sequence cannot complete while any compliance step is blocked

name: Offboarding Sentinel
purpose: Generates 11-step offboarding sequences. Blocks completion until reassignments are clear (no remaining engagement_access grants), then collects the Partner-signed audit pack.
guardrails: Reassignment-gate step blocks until all active grants on the person are revoked
Audit-pack signing is Partner-only
On finalize, person status flips to `former` and remaining grants are revoked

name: Roster Steward
purpose: Daily compliance scan. Emits Pane A items for visa, Iqama, GOSI, WPS, and master-agreement expirations at 30/60/90 day windows.
guardrails: Reference numbers are read in redacted form only — raw values never leave the database
Pane A item ids are deterministic per (record, bucket, user) — no duplicates

name: Skill Mapper
purpose: On-demand: scans engagements, deliverable versions, and Atelier asset authorship/promotion to propose agent_inferred skill rows on employees. Never auto-verifies; never proposes for partner-firm resources.
guardrails: Hard exclusion: partner_firm_resource workers never receive proposals
Skips rows that are blocked by stronger human sources or prior dismissals
Confidence is capped at 0.85 — verification stays a human decision
human_checkpoints: Engagement Lead / Operations / Partner verifies or dismisses each proposed row

name: Time Steward
purpose: Drafts weekly timesheets from calendar events, meeting attendance, deliverable edits, and Salon decisions. Writes immutable signal rows so approvers can trace every proposed hour back to its evidence. Never auto-submits.
guardrails: Never auto-submits — humans always click Submit
Never proposes for partner-firm resources (their hours come via partner-firm CSV)
Caps any single day at 10 drafted hours; routes >14h to suspicious-pattern flag at submit

name: Utilization Analyst
purpose: Translates the firm's deterministic utilization, realization, and burn numbers into a partner-grade narrative. Refuses generation when the numeric block is missing or stale.
guardrails: Refuses when numeric_block is missing or all-zero (no rows yet)
Never invents numbers — every claim is anchored to a snapshot value
Recommends concrete actions (re-look pricing, rebench), not 'communicate'
human_checkpoints: Partner reviews narrative before sharing externally

name: Burn Sentinel
purpose: Watches every active engagement; emits a Pane A item to the Engagement Lead the moment burn-rate crosses 60 / 80 / 100 % of planned hours.
guardrails: Idempotent: one alert per (engagement, threshold-band) — never re-fires
Hourly gate to avoid alert spam
100% crosses are always priority=high
human_checkpoints: Engagement Lead acknowledges the Pane A item
